Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub.: Audio recording of Earnings Call held for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the audio recording of the Company’s 
Earnings Call held today i.e. on October 30, 2026, regarding discussion on operational and financial 
performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 & H1 of FY 2026-27) is 
available on the Company’s website at https://www.nfil.in/uploads/investor/financial/nfil-audio-
earnings-call-q2fy-2026-27.mp3  
 
This intimation is also being made available on the Company’s website at www.nfil.in.  
 
Request you to take the aforesaid information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For NAVIN FLUORINE INTERNATIONAL LIMITED 
 
 
Niraj B. Mankad 
President Legal and Company Secretary 
 
 
Niraj 
Mankad

by Niraj Mankad
